title: Project status?
author: bluenoemi
body_preview: I've used django-model-utils for decades now, and was hoping to include it in a new project.  But it appears that the last release was in 2024 and is compatible only up to Django 5.1.  There have clearly been a fair number of commits since then, but no releases.  So two questions:  1. Will the current version run with Django 5.2 or 6.0? 2.
